design.name: 蝎尾弩卫
design.brief: A scorpion-centaur archer: the upper body of a veiled desert huntress (face hidden by a gold-coin veil, glowing white-gold eyes, Dunhuang-style jewellery, bronze arm bracers) joined at the waist to the body of a giant dark red desert scorpion with eight segmented legs and two big pincers. Its curled scorpion tail ends in a built-in bronze crossbow instead of a stinger, with a swollen glowing white-gold venom sac at the tail base (weak spot). She carries NO bow, NO arrows and NO quiver: her only weapon is the crossbow on the tip of her own curled tail. Her human hands are empty, one raised to aim like a sight, each with a clearly separate thumb and four separate fingers.
design.weapon: her tail crossbow curled over her head and firing a glowing bolt forward, both hands empty
design.turnaround_pose: standing on all eight scorpion legs spread evenly to both sides, both big pincers resting forward on the ground a little apart, the human upper body upright on top of the scorpion body with the arms held slightly away from the body in a relaxed A-pose and both hands open and EMPTY (no bow, no arrows, no weapon in the hands), the veil and scarf hanging calmly, the segmented tail curled up and forward over the back in a high arc with the bronze tail crossbow on its tip pointing forward and NO bolt loaded, the glowing venom sac at the tail base
design.turnaround_digits: each human hand open with a separate thumb and four separate slightly spread fingers, clearly countable; all eight legs, both pincers, the whole curled tail and the tail crossbow fully inside the frame, never cut off, and in the side views the long scorpion body shown at full length.
